title: Here's what you'll need to watch Netflix in 4K on Chrome - Engadget
summary: While systems like macOS already come with native HEVC support, Windows users may need to purchase and install the HEVC Video Extensions package from the Microsoft Store to ensure they can watch 4K videos from Netflix on their PC using Chrome.
